summary: Asset ↔ Loan Bidirectional Linking feature testing complete. Backend endpoint GET /api/loans/{loan_id}/linked-assets working correctly (13/13 tests passed). Frontend navigation flows verified: Asset→Loan and Loan→Asset bidirectional navigation working via clickable cards.

issues: Linked Asset badge (from loan.linkedAssetId) not showing on Car Loan Velar because loan record has linkedAssetId=null. This is expected behavior - the velar asset links TO the loan, but the loan doesn't link back TO the asset. The bidirectional view is achieved via the new 'Assets Financed by This Loan' section on LoanForm which uses the reverse-lookup API.

critical_code_review_comments: Bidirectional linking works correctly but is one-directional in data: Asset has linkedLoanId pointing to Loan, but Loan doesn't store linkedAssetId for reverse lookup. The reverse lookup is done via the new API endpoint which queries assets by linkedLoanId. This is an acceptable design pattern.
Console warnings about 'span cannot be a child of option/select' in LoanForm.js - likely from React development tools or animation library, not affecting functionality.
